Searched HarperCollins, Google Books, Mitch Albom’s site, Publishers Weekly, epistolary, narrator, and point-of-view combinations; no additional accessible sustained publisher excerpt or second Tier A/B whole-structure source was found. The author-site reading-guide PDF was nondiagnostic.
person_note: The quotes repeatedly establish Benji’s participating first-person notebook voice but do not expose the separate Land strand. Live evidence resolves the structure: sustained Sea sections use Benji’s first person, while sustained Land sections narrate Inspector LeFleur in third person, with News interludes also woven through the novel. These are recurring base sections rather than isolated embedded speech, so the book is ALTERNATING. Confidence is medium because only one Tier A source supports ALTERNATING and the quote evidence supports only its first-person component; the required two exact-match Tier A/B sources for high confidence are not present.
